Built to maximize bandwidth and speed, this ZOTAC GeForce RTX 5060 Twin Edge 8GB GPU connects via PCI Express 5.0 x8 and requires a single 8-pin PCIe power connector, with a recommended PSU of 550W and total power consumption of 145W. Designed for immersive, high-resolution gaming, the ZOTAC GeForce RTX 5060 Twin Edge supports stunning visuals up to 4K at 480Hz or 8K at 165Hz using DSC (Display Stream Compression).
